errors.evidence: The BLEU score for α=0.9 is stated as 28.1, but the point in the plot is visibly above the 28.1 tick mark (approximately 28.12).
The description does not state the overall purpose of the charts, which is to show the effect of two different hyperparameters (α and p) on the BLEU score.

The description of the left chart omits the values for the intermediate data points at α=0.3 (BLEU ≈ 28.33) and α=0.7 (BLEU ≈ 28.4), only mentioning the start, peak, and end points. This is less detailed than the description for the right chart.
